info.title: Native (Augmented) - service
info.description: Augment/uses-resolved Native configuration for `service` — branches contributed by external Cisco-IOS-XE-* modules (augments) and cross-module groupings that the base native generator does not resolve. Generated from the merged YANG tree. **Paths:** 21.
